##### Project general facts

Noor at Midtown is a contemporary residential development by Deyaar, located within the award-winning Midtown community in Dubai Production City. Comprising seven elegant residential buildings, the project offers a diverse collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments designed to combine modern architecture with comfortable everyday living. Surrounded by landscaped open spaces and a vibrant community atmosphere, Noor at Midtown provides a well-balanced lifestyle where convenience, connectivity, and contemporary design come together.

Residents benefit from a wide range of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance well-being, recreation, and community living. Beautifully landscaped gardens, pedestrian-friendly boulevards, retail outlets, and leisure facilities create an inviting environment for families and professionals alike. With excellent access to Dubai's major highways and business districts, Noor at Midtown offers seamless connectivity while maintaining the peaceful character of a modern residential community.

The residences are finished with high-quality contemporary materials, featuring bright interiors, functional layouts, and elegant modern finishes that maximize comfort and natural light. The apartments are delivered without kitchen appliances, allowing homeowners to customize their kitchens according to their own preferences. All residences are offered unfurnished, providing the flexibility to create interiors that reflect each owner's personal style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City (DPC) is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

DPC also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
